title: Advances in computational and experimental approaches for deciphering transcriptional regulatory networks: Understanding the roles of cis-regulatory elements is essential, and recent research utilizing MPRAs, STARR-seq, CRISPR-Cas9, and machine learning has yielded valuable insights.
authors: Moeckel, Camille; Mouratidis, Ioannis; Chantzi, Nikol; Uzun, Yasin; Georgakopoulos-Soares, Ilias
journal: BioEssays : news and reviews in molecular, cellular and developmental biology
one_liner_zh: 综述了顺式调控元件与转录调控网络的计算和实验方法，涵盖机器学习及MPRA/CRISPR筛选，虽涉及TF结合但缺乏三维互作建模，方法可迁移但深度有限。
abstract: Understanding the influence of cis-regulatory elements on gene regulation poses numerous challenges given complexities stemming from variations in transcription factor (TF) binding, chromatin accessibility, structural constraints, and cell-type differences. This review discusses the role of gene regulatory networks in enhancing understanding of transcriptional regulation and covers construction methods ranging from expression-based approaches to supervised machine learning. Additionally, key experimental methods, including MPRAs and CRISPR-Cas9-based screening, which have significantly contributed to understanding TF binding preferences and cis-regulatory element functions, are explored. Lastly, the potential of machine learning and artificial intelligence to unravel cis-regulatory logic is analyzed. These computational advances have far-reaching implications for precision medicine, therapeutic target discovery, and the study of genetic variations in health and disease.
abstract_zh: 理解顺式调控元件对基因调控的影响面临诸多挑战，这些挑战源于转录因子（TF）结合、染色质可及性、结构约束及细胞类型差异所带来的复杂性。本综述探讨了基因调控网络在增进对转录调控理解中的作用，并涵盖了从基于表达的方法到监督式机器学习等构建方法。此外，本文还探讨了包括MPRAs和基于CRISPR-Cas9的筛选在内的关键实验方法，这些方法显著促进了我们对转录因子结合偏好及顺式调控元件功能的理解。最后，分析了机器学习和人工智能在揭示顺式调控逻辑方面的潜力。这些计算进展对精准医学、治疗靶点发现以及健康与疾病中遗传变异的研究具有深远意义。
